title: Ten years, iv
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (Ten Years Under the Table · deepening)
logline: Thursday. The vet's scale. A number. The vet says 'for ten, that's fine.' Wood hears 'for ten.' The strip draws the scale's needle and nothing else in the panel.

panels.composition: The vet's. A steel scale on the floor. BARNABY on it. WOOD crouched. A VET's legs and clipboard.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, an old dog standing on a steel floor scale at a vet's office with a thin man crouched beside it and a vet's legs and clipboard at the frame edge

panels.composition: The scale's needle. Only the needle. The number is not drawn.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a scale's needle pointing at an unlabeled place on a dial, nothing else in the panel, no words
brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a thin man's face hearing something and holding it

panels.composition: The dog off the scale, into Wood's arms, the vet's door, the parking lot beyond with the Datsun. The dog licks his ear. The strip lets it.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man carrying an old dog out of a vet's door toward a rusted small car as the dog licks his ear, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now
